title: Exchange statistics, spin-statistics, and three-generation multiplicity are outside SBT scope: a verified honest negative (the only SM/spin contact points -- F26 generations+parameters, F9 univalence, plus Hund/BEC/Higgs -- are imported declarations, not retrodictions)

original_card.one_sentence_claim: SBT does NOT reproduce the fermion/boson exchange-statistics dichotomy, the spin-statistics theorem, or the three-generation Standard-Model pattern; the corpus contains zero exchange-symmetry / antisymmetrization / Pauli / anyon machinery, and the only contact points (univalence (-1)^{2J} as one declared WWW superselection observable in F9, and the three-generation content + 19+ parameters in the F26 moduli instantiation) are imported declarations, not retrodictions.
original_card.target_known_fact: The spin-statistics theorem (Pauli/Fierz): integer-spin fields commute (Bose symmetry), half-integer-spin fields anticommute (Fermi antisymmetry, Pauli exclusion); plus the observed replication of Standard-Model quarks and leptons into exactly three generations.
original_card.scientific_domain: Quantum field theory / Standard Model structure (exchange statistics, spin-statistics, generation multiplicity)
original_card.minimum_viable_result: A one-page, fully grounded 'scope-boundary note': (1) an exhaustive-search certificate that the SBT corpus contains no exchange-statistics / spin-statistics / Pauli / anyon / generation-derivation machinery; (2) the two import-not-derivation readings of F9 (univalence) and F26 (three generations + 19+ parameters); (3) the explicit list of missing interfaces (exchange/permutation-symmetry sector, Lorentz/relativistic causality, multiparticle Hilbert space + Born valuation) required before any positive claim.
original_card.stronger_result: A no-go-style impossibility statement WITHIN SBT's declared scope: prove that no construction expressible in the frozen primitive vocabulary (finite Markov substrate Z, deterministic lens f, idempotent packaging E, monotone audit A, P1-P6) can yield a permutation-group representation distinguishing symmetric from antisymmetric multiparticle sectors. (FLAGGED VACUITY-PRONE: SBT cannot even express a multiparticle/tensor/Fock factorization, so the honest framing is 'not expressible', strictly weaker than a contentful no-go.)
original_card.fallback_result: The minimum-viable scope-boundary note as the sole deliverable: an honest, fully-cited negative that (i) blocks the over-claim 'SBT explains why there are three generations / why fermions vs bosons', and (ii) names the exact interfaces whose repair would be needed, analogous to the ledger's other documented negatives (no Born rule, no continuum).
original_card.baseline_comparison: SBT does strictly WORSE than the standard account here, and that is the point. Relativistic QFT + the spin-statistics theorem explain the fermion/boson dichotomy and Pauli exclusion from Lorentz invariance + microcausality + positive energy; the three-generation pattern is an accepted (if itself unexplained) empirical input. SBT recovers NEITHER and merely re-hosts the SM's already-declared structure as inputs to an abstract moduli/contingency theorem (F26). No recovery, no genuine reorganization; the value is in marking that silence honestly.
original_card.why_scientists_care: A sharp, defensible negative forecloses the most seductive over-claims a casual reader might infer from F26 listing the SM and F9 listing univalence. It names the interfaces (exchange/permutation-symmetry sector, relativistic causality, multiparticle Hilbert space + Born valuation) whose absence is the real obstruction, and inoculates against the P4-sector-as-statistics-sector false analogy.

opposite_world_test.explanation: In the predictive sense SBT explains NOTHING here, so trivially it could also 'fail to explain' the opposite. More sharply: the F26 moduli quotient is a content-free quotient-stability split that would equally host a two-generation, four-generation, all-boson, or fermion/boson-swapped Standard Model, because the fermion content and generation count enter purely as a DECLARED lawfulness predicate (input). F26 has zero machinery preferring three generations or fermion antisymmetry. This is exactly why these are imports, not retrodictions, and why the card forecloses 'SBT explains why fermions vs bosons / why three generations.' For the genuine exchange-statistics target there is no opposite-world issue because SBT cannot even express a symmetric-vs-antisymmetric multiparticle sector (no Fock/tensor structure).
